title: umetate generated params (params.json)
description: The generated, flattened param table (what the panel/MIDI sees). Validated by this schema; the patch's `params:` section (binding + display metadata) and its per-node params are its source.

id.description: The stable set_param id (the generated table indexes by it).

name.description: The user-facing name (a `params:` key, else the target path).

target.description: The flattened <instance>.<param> path this id backs.

display.description: The on-screen form of the value (the panel's per-param display scale).

rate.description: sample = re-derived per frame; block = every control block.
